objective: Wire up safety_override_until as an active read-site in hydragrow-controller-core to allow force-on safety override during manual actions.

acceptance.criterion: SafetyGuard::is_override_active returns true when now_ms < safety_override_until and false when now_ms >= safety_override_until or default.
MonitoringPhase safety guard check sites for nutrient dose budget, pH dose budget, refill limits, and drain limits consult is_override_active to bypass non-emergency safety blocks when active.
SystemContext apply_delta integration test verifies ContextDelta { safety_override_until: Some(t), .. } properly updates safety_override_until and reflects in is_override_active.
Controller-core verification suite passes including cargo fmt --check, cargo check, cargo clippy -- -D warnings, and cargo test.
acceptance.verification: cargo fmt --manifest-path hydragrow-controller-core/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo check --manifest-path hydragrow-controller-core/Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --manifest-path hydragrow-controller-core/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path hydragrow-controller-core/Cargo.toml
